_about: M3-ENV-10 post-import rules for the Coilspire temple kit (game/core/import/coilspire_kit_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules). The same LOD table as the Haluna kit and HalunaDresser's defaults (which still override them at runtime with the layout's values); every glTF slot maps to the kit's own materials folder. The kit exports no -col proxies yet; walk collision is m2-slice's (swap-in notes in the task file M3-ENV-10).
